Agra Fort is located in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. The walled imperial city of the Mughals in Agra, rebuilt in red sandstone by Emperor Akbar from 1565 and later embellished in white marble by Shah Jahan.

History of Agra Fort. The official Agra district tourism page describes Agra Fort as the walled imperia
title: Agra Fort

text:
ism page describes Agra Fort as the walled imperial city of the Mughals and states that Emperor Akbar rebuilt it in red sandstone from 1565, with later white-marble additions by Shah Jahan.

Architecture of Agra Fort. The fort's 2.5-kilometre ramparts enclose structures including Jahangir Mahal, Khas Mahal, Diwan-i-Aam, Diwan-i-Khas, Sheesh Mahal, Musamman Burj and Moti Masjid.
title: Agra Fort

Taj Mahal is located in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. Ivory-white marble mausoleum in Agra, built by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

History of Taj Mahal. The Taj Ma
title: Taj Mahal

text:
fe Mumtaz Mahal.

History of Taj Mahal. The Taj Mahal was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal. Construction began around 1632. The main mausoleum was completed around 1648, while additional elements of the complex were completed by 1653. It was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983.

Architecture of Taj Mahal. A masterpiece of Mughal architecture combining Persian, Islamic and Indian influences. The complex features a white-marble mausoleum on a ra
title: Taj Mahal

text: complex features a white-marble mausoleum on a raised platform, four minarets, a central dome, symmetrical Mughal gardens, decorative stone inlay, and red-sandstone mosque and guest-house structures.
title: Taj Mahal
